purpose: Defines the states and permitted transitions for confirmed ToC publication, ToC build runs, and DLID assignment runs; the transition tables are normative and disallowed transitions are rejected.
summary: State separation: ToC publication state and build progress change independently
Transition tables are normative; unlisted combinations are rejected by scripts
Confirmed ToC states: unbuilt or published; failures keep the previous version
Build run transitions B-01 to B-09 from start through candidate check to completion or failure
AI generation requests are limited to stages after change determination
Build completion returns counts and a detail file path
Reference check results: match, path mismatch, or missing in directory, with directory and time
DLID assignment run transitions E-01 to E-07 including duplicate original confirmation
Written DLIDs are not rolled back on failure; per-document failures are reported
Search, DLID resolution and checks hold no state
tasks: Implementing state transition guards in scripts
Implementing ToC build and rebuild flow
Implementing the DLID assignment operation embed-dlid
title: DES-004 状態モデルと許可遷移
